tests.name: Delete everything in order
100 000 values
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(2121)
values = [random.randint(-10**6, 10**6) for _ in range(100000)]
tests.setup:
h = MinHeap()
for v in values:
    h.insert(v)
out = [h.delete() for _ in range(len(values))]
tests.hint: Insert and delete must be O(log N). Don't sort or use min().
